card.name: Inside words at the letters "ag"
card.fires_on: The letters "ag" or "aga" when they fall partway through a longer word or name. Most often this is in "Mahaguthi", and also in words like "dapagliflozin", "Contagion", "Paragangliomas" and "Wagons".

modes.label: Mahaguthi name
modes.description: The "ag" piece inside the organization name Mahaguthi.

modes.label: Other long words
modes.description: "ag" or "aga" inside other long words or drug names.

card.plain: It fires on the "ag" sound in the middle of long or rare words, mostly the name Mahaguthi.
